name: Vat Phou and Associated Ancient Settlements within the Champasak Cultural Landscape
description: Vat Phou is a ruined Khmer temple complex in southern Laos, set on the slopes of Phou Kao mountain above the Mekong River. A long axis runs from the river plain up to a sanctuary beside a sacred spring, lined with shrines, ponds and causeways across about 10 km. Built between the 5th and 15th centuries, it still shows how a whole landscape was designed around Hindu belief.
